heroHeadline: Erdoğan Announces Two New Gabar Oil Fields as Fund Crisis Keeps Pressure on Ankara
heroSubtitle: Erdoğan said on Nov 9 that the Gaziler and Çardaklı fields hold about 135 million barrels in place, as COP31 opened in Antalya. The investment-fund scandal continues to dent confidence, with Bank of America flagging economic effects.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets (AP, Reuters, BBC, Washington Post, Euronews, Foreign Policy, Balkan Insight, Turkish Minute, Türkiye Today), Socialist International statements, and US State Department readouts.
